== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Wedge Antilles (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. Compared with [[Wedge Antilles]]. Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
